headerLines.text: Published by New York State Law Reporting Bureau pursuant to Judiciary Law § 431.

opinionLines.text: On review of submissions pursuant to section 500.11 of the Rules of the Court of Appeals (22 NYCRR 500.11), order reversed, defendant's plea vacated and case remitted to County Court, Schenectady County, for further proceedings on the indictments (*see People v Louree*, 8 NY3d 541 [2007]).
Concur: Chief Judge Kaye and Judges Ciparick, Graffeo, Read, Smith, Pigott and Jones.
